evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies Tor integration logic in src/torcontrol.cpp.
rationale: Prevents command and argument injection via the Tor control socket by strictly validating Tor v3 service IDs and cached private keys before reuse in ADD_ONION commands. While exploiting this requires a malicious or impersonated Tor daemon endpoint, unvalidated replies could otherwise allow hijacking inbound onion traffic or triggering Tor shutdowns upon node restart.
